$comment: Hand-curated outreach targets beyond employers (docs/28, phases 2-3, 2026-07-30). Three categories: 'launch' (directories and launch boards - submit, don't email), 'press' (desks and data-journalism outlets - pitch the data findings, verify the current contact before sending, reporters move beats constantly), 'backlink' (career-education orgs whose audience is literally mid-pivot - pitch a route page or the Adjacency Index as a resource, the ask is a link not a client). Status tracking reuses outreach_status with key 'cur:<slug>'. Keep entries honest: every 'why' should survive being read aloud to the target.

targets.name: Product Hunt
targets.why: Biggest one-day launch audience in tech. A career-data instrument with a live graph demos well.
targets.pitch: Launch the graph as the hero. Tuesday-Thursday, prepared gallery, founder comment ready.

targets.name: Hacker News (Show HN)
targets.why: The audience most likely to appreciate measured adjacency data and a dependency-free force graph. Also the harshest — bring the methodology.
targets.pitch: Show HN: I measured which careers 236k live job postings say your skills can reach. Lead with method, not marketing.

targets.name: Uneed
targets.why: Community launch platform that caps daily launches, so small products get real visibility. Indie-friendly.
targets.pitch: Standard listing. Indie/boutique framing fits the one-architect story.

targets.name: BetaList
targets.why: Early-adopter audience; permanent listing.
targets.pitch: Frame the employer board as the upcoming part; the instrument is live.

targets.name: StartupBase
targets.why: Daily launches plus ongoing directory visibility and newsletter distribution.
targets.pitch: Standard listing.

targets.name: Indie Hackers
targets.why: Not a directory - a community. The 'boutique second-income business, deliberately not a startup' doctrine IS an Indie Hackers story.
targets.pitch: Write the build story as a post: one architect, a day job, a scraper, and a no-VC doctrine. Do not just drop a link.

targets.name: SaaSHub
targets.why: Alternatives-directory with durable SEO pages; a listing is a permanent backlink.
targets.pitch: List as alternative to LinkedIn Career Explorer / job boards.

targets.name: AlternativeTo
targets.why: High-authority alternatives directory; users search 'X alternative' constantly.
targets.pitch: List as alternative to career-explorer tools; category career/jobs.

targets.name: Fazier
targets.why: Rising launch platform, lighter competition than PH; daily/weekly showcases.
targets.pitch: Standard listing.

targets.name: Smol Launch
targets.why: Week-long launch window instead of one day - better for a product without an audience yet.
targets.pitch: Standard listing.

targets.name: Launching Next
targets.why: Permanent directory listing, low effort.
targets.pitch: Standard listing.

targets.name: The Pudding
targets.why: Visual data essays - the adjacency graph and the mobility findings are exactly their form. They accept pitches and pay for collaborations.
targets.pitch: Pitch a visual essay from our data: where people actually go when they leave a profession, from 236k postings + observed mobility flows. Offer the dataset.

targets.name: FlowingData
targets.why: Nathan Yau features data projects and visualizations; a feature there reaches the entire data-viz community and links hard.
targets.pitch: Submit the graph as a project: force-directed career adjacency, tuned by hand, no D3.

targets.name: HR Brew (Morning Brew)
targets.why: Newsletter for HR professionals - the employer side of the pitch. Covers hiring tools and labor-market data.
targets.pitch: Pitch the adjacent-talent finding: N% of hard-to-fill roles are reachable by candidates with a different title. Verify current desk contact first.

targets.name: WorkLife (Digiday)
targets.why: Future-of-work desk; covers career pivots, hiring signal, ghost jobs.
targets.pitch: Ghost-jobs measurement or the title-collapse finding (42,254 dead titles). Verify current reporter on the beat first.

targets.name: HR Tech Feed / HR Technology Wire
targets.why: Aggregates HR-tech product news; accepts wire-style announcements. Low bar, real links.
targets.pitch: Product announcement when the employer board opens; data findings as news items.

targets.name: ERE.net
targets.why: Recruiter trade publication; accepts contributed articles. Recruiters are the buyer.
targets.pitch: Contributed piece: 'the adjacent-talent pool you are filtering out' with our numbers. Byline + link.

targets.name: TechCrunch (tips)
targets.why: Long shot at our size, but the Texas/LinkedIn ghost-jobs investigation gives a news hook our data can extend.
targets.pitch: Only pitch WITH a news hook: 'while Texas investigates LinkedIn, here is what ghost patterns look like across 236k postings from 15 sources.'

targets.name: Ask a Manager
targets.why: Huge jobseeker audience with deep trust; links in posts carry real referral traffic.
targets.pitch: Not a pitch target for features - offer the data when a relevant question runs (career change, ghost jobs). Light touch only.

targets.name: Course Report
targets.why: THE bootcamp directory and review site; their content is career-change guides that cite outcome data. High authority.
targets.pitch: Offer route/salary data for their guides: what a bootcamp grad's target role pays and which prior careers are closest to it. Ask: citation link.

targets.name: CareerFoundry
targets.why: UX/data bootcamp whose entire audience is mid-pivot; their blog publishes career-change guides constantly.
targets.pitch: Their 'can I become a UX designer from X' articles can cite our measured readiness for that exact route. Link to the route page.

targets.name: Ironhack
targets.why: Global bootcamp (UX, data, web); blog covers career-change questions our routes answer with numbers.
targets.pitch: Same route-page citation angle; they have EU campuses, our EU salary data helps them.

targets.name: General Assembly
targets.why: The biggest reskilling brand; career-services teams assemble resource lists for grads.
targets.pitch: Pitch career services, not marketing: the route pages as a free resource for career coaches.

targets.name: Springboard
targets.why: Mentor-led career-change bootcamp; publishes salary guides that need sources.
targets.pitch: Their salary guides can cite our measured bands with a methodology link.

targets.name: Merit America
targets.why: Nonprofit reskilling for workers without degrees - the skills-over-titles thesis is their thesis.
targets.pitch: Offer the data for their program design and grant reporting; nonprofit links are clean.

targets.name: Flatiron School
targets.why: Coding/data/cyber bootcamp with an active blog on career outcomes.
targets.pitch: Route-page citation angle for 'from X to software engineer' content.

targets.name: Le Wagon
targets.why: International bootcamp; strong European presence matches our EU salary coverage.
targets.pitch: EU salary + route data for their country pages.

targets.name: Interaction Design Foundation
targets.why: UX education at scale with enormous literature/resource pages; a resource listing there is a durable, topical link.
targets.pitch: Offer the architect->UX and graphic-designer->UX route pages for their career-change literature.

targets.name: Peerlist Launchpad
targets.why: Professional network for builders; weekly launch cycle voted by developers and designers - our exact early audience.
targets.pitch: Launch into a weekly cycle; the graph demos well to this crowd.

targets.name: MicroLaunch
targets.why: Product Hunt-style but intimate, built for micro-SaaS; monthly cohorts of builders.
targets.pitch: Standard listing; boutique framing fits.

targets.name: Dev Hunt
targets.why: Launch venue specifically for developer tools; the dependency-free graph and open method play well.
targets.pitch: Frame as a data instrument with a documented method.

targets.name: Tiny Startups
targets.why: Lightweight launch platform, fast approval, badge + backlink; good for first versions.
targets.pitch: Standard listing.

targets.name: Startup Stash
targets.why: Curated directory of startup resources; durable listing.
targets.pitch: Submit under career/hiring tools.

targets.name: TripleTen
targets.why: Online career accelerator for busy professionals moving into tech - mid-pivot audience, active blog that ranks.
targets.pitch: Their career-change guides can cite our measured routes into the roles they teach.

targets.name: Designlab
targets.why: UX Academy; mentor-led career switchers into UX. Publishes 'best bootcamps' style content that needs data.
targets.pitch: Route pages into ux-designer (and our UX salary bands) as citable sources.

targets.name: BrainStation
targets.why: Bootcamp with career guides content arm ('are bootcamps worth it') - exactly where a measured readiness number belongs. NOTE: Canadian HQ - backlink pitch via form/editors, not cold email under CASL.
targets.pitch: Offer readiness + salary data for their career guides; no cold email, use their contact form.

targets.name: App Academy
targets.why: Premium coding bootcamp; outcome-focused content.
targets.pitch: From-X-to-software-engineer route citations.

targets.name: Per Scholas
targets.why: Nonprofit, no-cost IT training in 20+ cities for underrepresented communities; the skills-over-titles thesis in practice. Clean, high-trust links.
targets.pitch: Offer route/salary data for program design and grant reporting.

targets.name: Career Karma
targets.why: Bootcamp matchmaker + huge SEO content operation ranking for career-change queries; their listicles cite sources.
targets.pitch: Salary bands and route readiness as citable data for their rankings.

targets.name: Clay
targets.why: SF brand + UX agency for global tech brands; hires product/brand designers - adjacent-talent prospect in our launch vertical.
targets.pitch: Concierge intro: designers adjacent to their open roles (brand->product, graphic->UX), measured.

targets.name: Ramotion
targets.why: SF design and product studio (branding, UX/UI, front-end); boutique scale means the founder reads email.
targets.pitch: Adjacent-talent intros for design roles; small enough for concierge.

targets.name: Ueno
targets.why: Restructured 2025 as a boutique strategic agency; design-led, senior-heavy.
targets.pitch: Adjacent senior talent (creative-director-adjacent routes).

targets.name: BASIC/DEPT
targets.why: Digital branding/design agency; hires across brand, product, motion.
targets.pitch: Adjacent-talent intros; motion-designer and brand-designer routes.

targets.name: Pentagram
targets.why: The largest independent design consultancy, partner-run; a single placed candidate or a data citation from them carries outsized weight.
targets.pitch: Long shot: offer the design-career mobility data to a partner's team; citation or talk, not a sale.
